tools.name: censais_services
tools.description:
List the software and AI services Censais offers to clients, how a project
runs (steps and typical durations) and how to get in touch. Use this when someone
is looking for a team to build a web app, AI assistant, data/comparison engine or MVP.

tools.name: sketch_project
tools.description:
Turn a short project idea into a first sketch: core modules and features,
a phased plan with durations, and the key questions to answer first. Use this
when someone describes software they want built. It is a rough first-pass
estimate, not a quote; present it that way.
